text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Classes are over! I did my best in training again! #ItsBreakTime for #CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Great work, Curren Chan! Where are you heading now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks! ♪ I'm off to find the kind of cuteness that can put a smile on everyone's face! ☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Curren Chan. She uses the handle "Curren" on social media and is incredibly popular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the moment, however, another Umamusume is gazing intently at her from a distance…
choice_data_list: Do you need to talk to Curren about something, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Waaagh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You startled me… Please refrain from doing that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ahem… You asked whether I have business with Curren, yes? The answer is that I do not.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, I find that Curren carries herself in a splendid manner, and thus I decided to observe her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Despite leading a busy life with an arduous training regimen, she still manages to maintain a high frequency of posts on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And the quality of her content remains consistently high. As a result, her Umasta page is extremely cute.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm?! I… I would not claim to be a fan. As a practitioner of the Kongo Yaegaki style, my heart remains steadfast!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Well, p-perhaps it wavers slightly… but Curren does not rely on her innate cuteness alone—she is always refining her craft…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And that is why I hold the utmost respect for her. I hesitate to call myself a fan, however—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I had no idea you were a fan of mine, Yaeno. I'm so happy! My heart skipped a beat just now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We should totally run together sometime! I hope you'll keep cheering me on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I… I-I… I…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to protect you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can deny it no longer! I simply cannot bear to forsake so lovely a flower!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must protect you using my Kongo Yaegaki style!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I implore you! Please allow me to defend you from harm!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow, this is amazing! ♪ Have I finally reached bodyguard-level popularity?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I don't know what to do! I'm really pleased you want to keep me safe, but I think having security might be a teensy bit much…
choice_data_list: It'll be fine! Let her protect you!
Maybe you should try calming her down first.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right! I've gotta match the energy of my fans!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Will you protect my cuteness, Yaeno? Pretty please! ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Thank you for agreeing to this interview Curren Chan. It's very much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: S-so first off… Um, uhh…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Sorry, who is that intimidating individual behind you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno is my valiant knight. ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Your "knight"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan later tells me that, perhaps due to Yaeno Muteki's intimidating aura, the reporter's questions were far less pointed than usual.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Great idea! I'm just so cute that she can't think straight! Okay, so what should I do?
choice_data_list: You're going to have to say uncute things!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? I don't think I know how. ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I mean, I've never not been cute—not even for a millisecond! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is so CUUUTE!
